fields.name: Wide Push-ups
fields.description: Push-up variation with wider hand placement to emphasize chest.
fields.instructions:
1. Place hands wider than shoulder-width
2. Lower chest to floor
3. Push back up keeping core tight

fields.name: Diamond Push-ups
fields.description: Tricep-focused push-up with hands forming a diamond shape.
fields.instructions:
1. Form a diamond with index fingers and thumbs
2. Lower chest toward hands
3. Push back up, keeping elbows close

fields.name: Pike Push-ups
fields.description: Shoulder-focused push-up performed in a pike position.
fields.instructions:
1. Form an inverted V with hips high
2. Bend elbows to lower head toward floor
3. Push back up

fields.name: Decline Push-ups
fields.description: Push-up with feet elevated to target upper chest and shoulders.
fields.instructions:
1. Place feet on a chair or elevated surface
2. Perform a push-up with hands on floor
3. Keep body straight throughout

fields.name: Jump Squats
fields.description: Explosive squat variation that builds power and burns calories.
fields.instructions:
1. Squat down to parallel
2. Explode upward jumping off the floor
3. Land softly and immediately squat again

fields.name: Sumo Squats
fields.description: Wide-stance squat targeting inner thighs and glutes.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes pointed out
2. Lower hips keeping chest up
3. Push through heels to stand

fields.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
fields.description: Single-leg squat with rear foot elevated for maximum quad and glute activation.
fields.instructions:
1. Place rear foot on a chair
2. Lower front knee toward floor
3. Push through front heel to stand

fields.name: Reverse Lunges
fields.description: Lunge stepping backward, easier on knees than forward lunges.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand tall
2. Step one foot backward and lower knee toward floor
3. Push through front heel to return

fields.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
fields.description: Unilateral glute bridge for greater glute and hamstring activation.
fields.instructions:
1. Lie on back, one knee bent foot flat, other leg extended
2. Drive through planted heel to lift hips
3. Squeeze glute at top, lower with control

fields.name: Donkey Kicks
fields.description: Glute isolation exercise performed on all fours.
fields.instructions:
1. Start on hands and knees
2. Kick one leg back and up, keeping knee bent
3. Squeeze glute at top, lower and repeat

fields.name: Fire Hydrants
fields.description: Hip abductor exercise targeting glutes and outer hips.
fields.instructions:
1. Start on hands and knees
2. Lift one knee out to the side keeping it bent
3. Lower and repeat

fields.name: Calf Raises
fields.description: Bodyweight exercise to strengthen and build the calf muscles.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart
2. Rise onto toes as high as possible
3. Lower slowly back down

fields.name: Bicycle Crunches
fields.description: Dynamic core exercise targeting abs and obliques.
fields.instructions:
1. Lie on back, hands behind head
2. Bring opposite elbow to knee while extending other leg
3. Alternate sides in a pedaling motion

fields.name: Leg Raises
fields.description: Core exercise targeting lower abs.
fields.instructions:
1. Lie flat on back, legs straight
2. Raise legs to 90 degrees
3. Lower slowly without touching floor

fields.name: Russian Twists
fields.description: Rotational core exercise targeting obliques.
fields.instructions:
1. Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly
2. Clasp hands together
3. Rotate torso side to side

fields.name: Superman Hold
fields.description: Back extension exercise strengthening the lower back and glutes.
fields.instructions:
1. Lie face down, arms extended overhead
2. Lift arms, chest, and legs off floor simultaneously
3. Hold briefly, lower and repeat

fields.name: Bear Crawl
fields.description: Full-body crawling movement building core stability and coordination.
fields.instructions:
1. Start on hands and knees, knees hovering 2 inches off floor
2. Move opposite hand and foot forward
3. Keep back flat and hips low

fields.name: Inchworm
fields.description: Dynamic warm-up and full-body mobility exercise.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand tall, hinge forward and place hands on floor
2. Walk hands out to plank position
3. Walk hands back to feet and stand

fields.name: High Knees
fields.description: Running in place with exaggerated knee drive for cardio and core.
fields.instructions:
1. Run in place
2. Drive knees up to hip height
3. Pump arms and stay on balls of feet

fields.name: Butt Kicks
fields.description: Cardio drill that targets hamstrings and improves running form.
fields.instructions:
1. Jog in place
2. Kick heels up toward glutes with each step
3. Keep torso upright

fields.name: Squat Jumps to Tuck
fields.description: Advanced plyometric combining squat jump with tuck for explosive power.
fields.instructions:
1. Squat down
2. Explode up and tuck knees to chest
3. Land softly and immediately squat

fields.name: Plank to Downward Dog
fields.description: Dynamic movement combining core stability with shoulder and hamstring stretch.
fields.instructions:
1. Start in plank position
2. Push hips up into downward dog
3. Return to plank and repeat

fields.name: Tricep Dips
fields.description: Bodyweight tricep exercise using a chair or low surface.
fields.instructions:
1. Place hands on edge of chair, feet extended
2. Lower body by bending elbows
3. Push back up to start

fields.name: Hollow Body Hold
fields.description: Gymnastics-based core exercise building total core tension.
fields.instructions:
1. Lie on back, press lower back into floor
2. Raise shoulders and legs off floor
3. Arms extended overhead, hold position

fields.name: V-Ups
fields.description: Advanced core exercise targeting upper and lower abs simultaneously.
fields.instructions:
1. Lie flat, arms overhead
2. Simultaneously raise legs and torso
3. Reach hands toward feet, lower with control

fields.name: Lateral Lunges
fields.description: Side lunge targeting inner thighs, glutes, and quads.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand with feet together
2. Step wide to one side and lower hips over that foot
3. Push back to center and repeat other side

fields.name: Squat Pulse
fields.description: Isometric squat hold with small pulses for muscle endurance.
fields.instructions:
1. Lower into squat position
2. Pulse up and down a few inches
3. Keep tension throughout

fields.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
fields.description: Anti-rotation core exercise performed in plank position.
fields.instructions:
1. Start in high plank
2. Tap one hand to opposite shoulder
3. Alternate sides keeping hips stable

fields.name: Spiderman Push-ups
fields.description: Push-up variation adding hip flexor stretch and core challenge.
fields.instructions:
1. Start in push-up position
2. As you lower, bring one knee to same-side elbow
3. Push up and return leg, alternate sides

fields.name: Step-ups
fields.description: Unilateral leg exercise using a step or chair.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand in front of a step or chair
2. Step up with one foot, drive opposite knee up
3. Step back down and repeat

fields.name: Toe Touches
fields.description: Core and flexibility exercise targeting abs and hamstrings.
fields.instructions:
1. Lie on back, legs raised to 90 degrees
2. Crunch up reaching hands toward toes
3. Lower with control

fields.name: Squat to Calf Raise
fields.description: Compound movement combining squat and calf raise for full lower body.
fields.instructions:
1. Perform a squat
2. As you stand, rise onto toes
3. Lower heels and repeat

fields.name: Plank Hip Dips
fields.description: Oblique-focused plank variation with lateral hip rotation.
fields.instructions:
1. Start in forearm plank
2. Rotate hips to dip one side toward floor
3. Return to center and dip other side
